desc: Chambered in 45-90 and 45-70. Straight grip Grade I walnut stock with carbine-style forearm. Steel receiver with polished blued finish and saddle ring has been drilled and tapped for receiver mount. 22" round barrel with polished blued finish and steel barrel band. Full-length magazine tube holds 8 cartridges. Carbine ladder-style rear sight and blade front sight.
